title: The Evolution of Multi-Tool Orchestration in LLM Agents
subtitle: From Single-Tool Integration to Complex Agent Ecosystems

chapters.english_title: Foundations of LLM Agents and Tool Integration

sections.heading: הצורך בסוכנים המסוגלים להשתמש בכלים
sections.summary: Overview of why large language models require access to external tools and how single-tool integration evolved into multi-tool ecosystems.

sections.heading: ארכיטקטורה בסיסית של סוכנים
sections.summary: Fundamental patterns for building LLM-based agents, including decision-making loops, action execution, and feedback mechanisms.

chapters.english_title: The Model Context Protocol: Standardizing Tool Exposure

sections.heading: הצורך בתקן פתוח לחשיפת כלים
sections.summary: Motivation for developing an open standard protocol (MCP) to expose tools and resources to AI systems in a consistent manner.

sections.heading: מבנה ותכונות ה-MCP
sections.summary: Technical specifications of the Model Context Protocol, including message formats, resource discovery, and tool invocation patterns.

sections.heading: אסטרטגיות בחירת כלים
sections.summary: Methods and patterns for agents to select appropriate tools from a toolkit based on task requirements and context.

sections.heading: תיאום סדרתי מול מקבילי
sections.summary: Comparison of sequential tool execution chains versus parallel tool invocation and their trade-offs in performance and complexity.

sections.heading: ניהול מצב וזיכרון בחלוקות כלים
sections.summary: Techniques for maintaining state consistency across multiple tool calls, including context passing and result aggregation.

sections.heading: דפוסי ניהול היררכיים
sections.summary: Manager-based hierarchical delegation patterns where higher-level agents coordinate the actions of specialized sub-agents.

sections.heading: למידת חיזוק רב-סוכנית
sections.summary: Hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches for optimizing agent coordination and tool selection policies.

sections.heading: תקשורת בין-סוכנית וסכום
sections.summary: Communication protocols and message passing mechanisms that enable effective coordination between multiple agents in an orchestrated system.

chapters.english_title: Security and Robustness in Multi-Tool Agent Systems

sections.heading: הוקעות הזרקת הנושא
sections.summary: Analysis of prompt injection attacks where adversaries manipulate agent behavior through crafted inputs to override intended tool selection.

sections.heading: הגבלת הרשאות והפחתת סיכונים
sections.summary: Mechanisms for enforcing principle of least privilege, sandboxing tool execution, and preventing privilege escalation in agent systems.

sections.heading: וידוא ותוקף כלים
sections.summary: Techniques for validating tool outputs, detecting anomalous behavior, and ensuring the integrity and trustworthiness of tool invocations.

chapters.english_title: Future Directions and Evolution of Agent Orchestration

sections.heading: דפוסים משתנים בתיאום סוכנים
sections.summary: Emerging patterns and evolving best practices in multi-tool orchestration, including adaptive agent behavior and dynamic tool discovery.

sections.heading: שאלות מחקר פתוחות
sections.summary: Unresolved challenges and future research directions including improved agent reasoning, security, scalability, and interoperability across agent ecosystems.
